newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore raising offshore lending limit to S$200m.
newsitem.headline: Singapore raising offshore lending limit to S$200m.

text.p: Singapore will raise its lending limit for offshore banks from Singapore $150 million to S$200 million, a senior monetary official said on Tuesday.
Monetary Authority of Singapore Managing Director Lee Ek Tieng said the change would be effective from Wednesday.
Speaking at the annual dinner of the Association of Banks in Singapore, he said this would enable international banks to better serve home customers which have established operations in Singapore.
